sample_unit: native Thai-speaking medical physicists and postgraduate students rating videos
unlisted_practices: Using AI avatar video generation with machine translation to create multilingual patient education videos, assessed with BLEU scores and expert Likert ratings

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the feasibility and quality of using a generative AI video/translation tool (HeyGen) to produce Thai-language patient education videos, evaluated offline by bilingual medical physicists and students.
